summary: Receives acknowledgement without automatically clearing the underlying alarm condition.
description: Receives acknowledgement without automatically clearing the underlying alarm condition. A room DC interface connects station battery distribution, alarm contacts and operating circuits. DC supplies may remain energized when the room's normal AC supply is unavailable, so their source and distribution boundaries must be shown separately.

In a switchroom, the station battery can continue supplying protection and breaker controls during an AC supply interruption. The alarm system should distinguish charger loss from a low battery condition. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Operator acknowledgement” at the input and “Acknowledged alarm state” at the output. Acknowledgement and fault reset have different meanings.
